column3: Manami Route ・ Just Like a Galge
Ah crap, I dozed off. I wasn't listening to what Manami was saying.
Ugh, again?! Okay, Manami, calm down! I'm not going anywhere, so just, just take it slow. W-What's wrong?
What in the world is going on??
Manami, first, take a deep breath!
Okay... Calmed down yet?  Now, take your time and speak slowly...
Nope, there's definitely something you want to talk about, right?
If you phrase it that way, I really won't be able to say it...
That way...? No, no I'm not angry.
It's just, I want to make sure I hear what you want to say.
Okay, I get it. If you don't want to talk now, then don't force yourself.
Sorry, that's not it... it's, you know...
Okay, I'll say it... Erm... it's like...
When we were walking, my arm got in your way, right? My bad.
Then what is it about my arm?
Ahh... Okay, so, what is it?
I want to hold Kyou-chan's arm.
I want to try holding your arm...
You're saying... you mean that... Right?
Just like a lovey-dovey twitterpated couple?
Ah, it's not that I don't want to...
Holding hands yesterday was okay, but holding my arm is super embarrassing!
Ugh, crap, now she's all depressed!
I see... W-What do you mean...
Oh, no.  You don't need to get all worked up. Just the arm, right?
